technology_name: A NIOBIUM DISULFIDE BASED SELF-POWERED PHOTODETECTOR
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional high-sensitivity photodetectors require complex refrigeration loops or external voltage inputs to function stably under varying ambient temperature windows.
description: An ambient-temperature stable, lightweight, and flexible self-powered photodetector utilizing a niobium disulfide ($NbS_2$) base layer capable of generating highly stable photo-voltages via charge-carrier diffusion mechanics.
applications: Portable handheld optical spectrometers, wearable UV/visible light exposometers, industrial laser alignment sensors, and distributed field imaging grids.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, MedTech & Health Care
